claim: The two backends do not compute the same w. The projection matrix carries hint ommc_Projection, whose fast path in OMediaMatrix.h computes w = z*m[2][3] and never reads m[3][3], so the software pipeline gets w = z_view exactly. D3D, handed the same matrix with _44=1, computes w = z_view + w_in. With gen_vertex writing xyzw[3]=1.0f this is w = z+1 on the hardware path and w = z on the software path.
speaker: n/a

claim: Software path, as read from source: OMediaPipeline::gen_vertex stores model-space xyzw with w=1 plus normal, colour and uv; end_gen_polygon applies model_view then projection per vertex (with an early transform+backface-cull fast path for the first triangle when Gouraud lighting is on), Sutherland-Hodgman-style clipping runs per plane in clip_polygon, transform_homogenous_coord performs the perspective divide and returns inv_w, backface_culled rejects on the sign of the z component of the cross product of the two edge vectors (n.z >= 0 culls), compute_light does per-vertex lighting, and OMediaOMTRenderPort dispatches to render_polygon_points / _lines / _surface / _shaded / _texture32 / _texture16, which scale u,v by texture width/height times inv_w for perspective-correct mapping and drive OMediaSegmentRasterizer against a 16-bit z-buffer.
